messages:
marco: Heads-up 1: we need a lightweight process for QBR slot handoffs + MDF triggers. Idea: use a signed slot reservation + a 2-stage MDF release tied to a lightweight scorecard.
alyssa: Good call. Two-stage release makes finance happier. What metrics are we gating on?
jing: I'd focus on 3 signals: co-sell pipeline influenced (3mo lookback), marketplace activation (first 30-day dev bounce), and enablement completion (partner-run enablement + submitted assets).
samir: Agree. Proposed quick formula (rounded):
```
score = round(0.45 * pipeline_score + 0.35 * marketplace_score + 0.20 * enablement_score)
```
Set qualifying threshold at 60 to start, can tune after 1 cycle.
marco: For slot logistics: reserve = 50% MDF + signed agenda + named exec sponsor. Release remainder after post-QBR packet + score >= threshold. If score < threshold, ops retains remainder and partner gets detailed feedback.
finance: FYI, we need a cap per partner per quarter to limit runway exposure. Recommend $25k cap for platinum, $12k gold, $5k silver.
alyssa: Those caps look OK. We should also require a rollback clause if partner cancels <14 days before QBR. Refund policy needs to be explicit.
jing: Ops checklist idea: pre-QBR checklist (agenda, test demo, logins, data privacy check), day-of ops runbook (AV lead, slide deck template, customer intro script), post-QBR packet (recording, deck, outcome_metrics). I'll draft.
samir: We should also add a 'handoff note' in the partner CRM when slot reserved so AMs and sales know the commitments. Automate with a webhook from booking form.
ops-bot: Reminder: create booking form template -> /templates/partner_qbr_booking_form (owner: marco)
marco: Next steps: alyssa model cashflow impact and refund scenarios; samir add CRM webhook + update score calc; jing produce checklist & deck template; finance to confirm cap values by EOD Friday. I'll run a quick pilot with two SIs next cycle.
alyssa: On it. I'll run sensitivity across pipeline weightings.
finance: Confirmed tentatively, will confirm final by EOD Fri. Need a short sample contract clause for refund/escrow.
samir: I'll mock the webhook payload and a small script ops can use to mark score outcomes.
jing: I'll attach sample agenda and a short facilitator notes doc to the playbook.
marco: Great. Ops sync scheduled tomorrow 09:30 for 20m to finalize wording. ops-bot: event created: "QBR slot handoff + MDF trigger" 09:30 tomorrow (invitees: marco, alyssa, jing, samir, finance).
marco: Closing: aim to have playbook PR by next week so we can run pilot.
